An elegant and efficient way to determine the quarter of a given month is by using integer arithmetic. Subtracting 1 from the month shifts the range from $1\text{–}12$ to $0\text{–}11$. Performing integer division by 3 maps this to $0\text{–}3$, and adding 1 shifts it back to the correct quarter range of $1\text{–}4$.

Confidence Level: 100%

```python
def quarter(month):
    """Returns the quarter number (1-4) for a given calendar month number (1-12)."""
    return (month - 1) // 3 + 1
```
